title.zh: Blockstream Rejects Ransom Demand After Liquid Bitcoin Exploit
title.en: Blockstream Rejects Ransom Demand After Liquid Bitcoin Exploit

current_state.zh: Blockstream rejected a ransom demand after an exploit on the Liquid Bitcoin sidechain, with 3,400 BTC returned, about 598.5 BTC still outstanding, and peg-outs disabled as transactions resumed.
current_state.en: Blockstream rejected a ransom demand after an exploit on the Liquid Bitcoin sidechain, with 3,400 BTC returned, about 598.5 BTC still outstanding, and peg-outs disabled as transactions resumed.
